Bonus Feat.description: At 4th level and once more at 8th level, a pious templar receives a bonus feat. These feats must be selected from those available as fighter bonus feats. If the pious templar chooses a feat that must be applied to a particular weapon (such as Improved Critical), she must apply it to her deity's favored weapon.

Damage Reduction 1/?.description: Beginning at 3rd level, a pious templar can absorb a portion of the damage from every hit she takes. She gains damage reduction 1/?. When she reaches 7th level, this increases to damage reduction 2/?.

Mettle.description: Through divine favor, a pious templar can resist magical effects that would normally harm her. When she succeeds on a Will or Fortitude saving throw against a spell that normally has a reduced effect on a successful save, she instead negates the spell's effect entirely. This applies only to spells whose saving throw entries indicate a partial or reduced effect, such as "Will partial" or "Fortitude half."

Smite.description: Once per day, a pious templar of 2nd level or higher can attempt a single melee strike with a +4 bonus on the attack roll and bonus damage equal to her pious templar level. She must declare the smite before rolling the attack. At 6th level she gains a second daily use, and at 10th level a third. If the pious templar already possesses a smite evil or similar smite ability from another class (such as paladin or a cleric with the Destruction domain), she instead receives one additional daily use of that ability (two additional uses at 7th level). The attack bonus remains unchanged, but the damage bonus is calculated using the character's combined levels in pious templar and the class that granted the original smite.

Spells per Day.description: A pious templar can cast a limited number of divine spells. She must have a Wisdom score of at least 10 + the spell's level to cast a given spell; a pious templar with Wisdom 10 or lower cannot cast any of these spells. Bonus spells and saving throw DCs are based on Wisdom (DC equals 10 + spell level + Wisdom modifier). When her allotment for a given spell level is 0, she can only cast bonus spells of that level, and if she has no bonus spell for that level she cannot cast spells of that level at all. The pious templar has access to her entire spell list and freely chooses which spells to prepare each day, preparing and casting them in the manner of a cleric (though she cannot spontaneously convert spells into cure or inflict spells). A good-aligned pious templar (or a neutral one who serves a good deity) draws from the paladin spell list. An evil pious templar (or a neutral one who serves an evil deity) draws from the blackguard spell list. A pious templar who is neither good nor evil and whose deity is also neither good nor evil may choose either the paladin or blackguard spell list; once this choice is made it is permanent.

Weapon Specialization.description: At 3rd level, the pious templar receives Weapon Specialization as a bonus feat, applied to her deity's favored weapon.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
